brief: A note-taking app in 3D space — recent notes float near, old ones drift away, connections are threads

dominant_strengths: Atmospheric dark palette with violet accents creates a contemplative, cosmic mood that aligns with the spatial metaphor
Depth hierarchy via scale and opacity (faded distant note, glowing nearby card) communicates the 'recent vs old' concept clearly
Tag pills and metadata typography are restrained and consistent, giving each note card a clean information hierarchy
dominant_weaknesses: Cards bleed off-screen on left and right edges, suggesting poor layout containment rather than intentional infinite-canvas affordance
The promised 'connection threads' are barely visible — faint dashed lines don't read as meaningful relationships between notes
Legend, FAB, and chrome controls feel like generic SaaS overlays bolted onto the spatial concept, breaking immersion
fix_priorities: Make connection threads first-class: animated, glowing, semantically colored lines linking related notes
Resolve edge-clipping — either fully show floating cards or fade them with a clear depth gradient
Strengthen z-depth cues with parallax, blur, and scale curves so 'drift' becomes felt rather than stated
Integrate chrome (Filter/Search/View, FAB) into the spatial language instead of flat top-bar buttons
rationale.norman_balance: Visceral mood is strong and reflective concept is intriguing, but behavioral clarity suffers — it's unclear how to navigate, connect, or interact.
rationale.intent_fit: Partially delivers the 3D-space note metaphor through depth and fading, but the 'threads as connections' promise is underbuilt and motion is only implied.
